description: This file is part of the Google Test framework, implementing platform-specific utilities, regex handling, file operations, environment variable parsing, and logging functionalities.

classes.name: RE
classes.description: A class for handling regular expressions, supporting POSIX Extended and simple regex implementations, with methods for matching and initialization.

classes.name: GTestLog
classes.description: A logging class for Google Test, supporting different severity levels and formatted output.

classes.name: CapturedStream
classes.description: A helper class for capturing output streams (stdout/stderr) during tests.

classes.name: AutoHandle
classes.description: A RAII wrapper for Windows HANDLEs to ensure proper resource management.

classes.name: Mutex
classes.description: A cross-platform mutex class with lazy initialization and thread safety features.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: A synchronization primitive for thread notification on Windows.

methods.name: GetThreadCount
methods.description: Returns the number of active threads in the current process, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: SleepMilliseconds
methods.description: Pauses execution for a specified number of milliseconds (Windows only).

methods.name: FormatFileLocation
methods.description: Formats a source file path and line number for error messages.

methods.name: FormatCompilerIndependentFileLocation
methods.description: Formats a source file location suitable for XML output, without platform-specific formatting.

methods.name: ParseInt32
methods.description: Parses a string for a 32-bit signed integer, with validation.

methods.name: FlagToEnvVar
methods.description: Converts a test flag name to its corresponding environment variable name.

methods.name: GetInjectableArgvs
methods.description: Retrieves the current injectable argument vector for death tests.

methods.name: SetInjectableArgvs
methods.description: Sets a new argument vector for death tests.

methods.name: ClearInjectableArgvs
methods.description: Clears the injectable argument vector for death tests.
